Thank you for your interest in the SNL Standby Process!
BOOK STANDBY RESERVATION

The SNL Standby Reservation opens Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST before each show.

Important: Duplicate requests for the same date are not allowed. If you submit more than once, only your latest request will count and determine your reservation number.

How to Get a Standby Reservation Number:

1. Book Your Reservation 

Provide your full name, email, and the number of people in your party (2 maximum are allowed).

2. Receive Standby Booking Confirmation Number

You’ll get an on-screen confirmation followed by an email confirmation once you are in our standby queue.

3. Get Your Standby Reservation Number

Standby reservation numbers are issued in the order received and sent by email until capacity is reached. Delivery of standby reservation numbers may be delayed due to the volume.

4. Check In, In Person

If you receive a reservation number, you must arrive to 49 W 49th St. at the NBC Studios Marquee (between Fifth & Sixth Avenues) between 6:00 PM EST and 7:00 PM EST on the Friday before the show. Bring your photo ID (matching first and last name on your reservation) and your reservation email. If you miss check-in or forget your ID, you’ll lose your place in line. Photos of IDs will not be accepted.

5. Line Up

You’ll be placed in line according to your reservation number.

6. Collect Your Standby Card

Cards are handed out at 12:01 AM EST Saturday morning (show day) only. Photo ID (matching first and last name) is required again. One card per person. Cards are not given out at any other time.

 

Please note that a standby card does not guarantee entry into the show.

For full details, visit: 

https://www.nbc.com/tickets/pages/tickets-and-nbc-studio-tour#snl
